items.title: When design becomes the organisation, and AI becomes the designer
items.excerpt: Argues that as AI takes over the act of designing, the designer's real object of work shifts to the organisation itself — shaping the systems, taste, and guardrails that machines design within. A fresh Design-AX framing distinct from the terminal/orchestration/taste essays already published.

items.title: What 32 design leaders do when told to move faster
items.excerpt: Design timelines are collapsing because AI turned weeks of research into days and afternoons of concepting into minutes — the piece surveys how 32 design leaders actually respond to the resulting speed pressure without wrecking craft.

items.title: Agent's Design — design resources built for Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, v0, Bolt, Lovable
items.excerpt: A packaged set of design resources aimed at stopping AI coding agents from shipping the same generic UI — feeding Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, v0, Bolt and Lovable with reusable design-system context so generated interfaces carry real taste.

items.title: This new AI model thinks in images, not just words
items.excerpt: After a decade of word-based LLMs, researchers are betting on models that reason directly in images rather than text — a shift toward visual-native AI that could reshape how designers and creatives collaborate with generative tools.

items.title: New AI super-assistant sits on your desk and 'works unlimited hours', handling everything from email to coding
items.excerpt: Autonomous' Intern 2 is a desktop AI agent with a voice and 'a mind' pitched at creatives — promising to take on the work of a small creative team across email, research and coding, testing how much of a studio's grunt work an always-on agent can absorb.
